node.statement: Lemma 5.3 (Second moment operator): M_mom^{(2)} = (1/n^2)(X_{n+2}X_{n+1} + (n+1,n+2))(Pi_sym^n tensor I^2) - Lower_mom, where Lower_mom = ((d+n)/n^2) d[n] integral |u><u|^{n+2} du lies in SoS(d) (being proportional to a positive integral of |u><u|^{n+2}). Proof: From Lemma 5.1 with k=2, expand the debiased second moment ((d+n)/n |v><v| - (1/n)I)^{tensor 2}, collect terms using Jucys-Murphy products.
